manifest.name: Authentication
manifest.description: Sign-in methods, group mappings for external users and a sign-in preview

providers.title: Sign-in methods
providers.breakGlass: Local accounts always work. The last local administrator cannot be removed or demoted, so it stays as the break-glass account when the identity provider is unavailable.
providers.none: No identity provider is configured. Configure OIDC with the KUBEBENCH_OIDC_* environment variables (see the configuration guide).
providers.requireGroupOff: May sign in but see no cluster
providers.configHint: Provider settings come from the server's environment and cannot be changed here. Secrets are never sent to the browser.

mappings.title: Group mappings
mappings.notice: Mappings are applied at every sign-in of an external user: their role and cluster access are re-computed from their groups and replace any manual change made in Users. Changes here take effect at the user's next sign-in.
mappings.empty: No group mappings yet. External users can sign in but see no cluster.
mappings.unknownClusterHint: No cluster of this name is registered. The mapping grants nothing until one is added.
mappings.deleteMessage: Members of the group lose this access at their next sign-in. Current sessions keep their access until then.

dialog.description: Members of the group get this access at their next sign-in.
dialog.groupHelp: The group name as the provider reports it (an OIDC groups claim value or an LDAP group DN). Matched exactly, ignoring case.
dialog.sourceHelp: Limit the mapping to the groups of one provider, or apply it to all.
dialog.roleHelp: Administrators manage KubeBench and have full access to every cluster. Viewers read a cluster; operators may also change it.
dialog.unknownCluster: No cluster of this name is registered yet; the mapping grants nothing until one is added.

errors.duplicate: This group already has a mapping for this provider and cluster.

preview.title: Test sign-in
preview.help: See what a user would get when signing in now, without creating a user or a session. Leave the groups empty to use the groups of the user's last sign-in (or, for a directory, the directory's).

failures.invalid_credentials: Invalid username or password, or no such user in the directory.
failures.account_disabled: The account is disabled at the provider.
failures.domain_not_allowed: The email domain is not allowed.
failures.no_matching_group: No group is mapped to a role, and users without one are refused.
failures.username_conflict: The username belongs to another account; external sign-ins never take over an account.
failures.invalid_username: The username cannot be used in KubeBench.
failures.invalid_request: The sign-in could not be verified.
failures.provider_error: The identity provider could not be reached.
